overall: The AG found the Boxborough Planning Board violated the Open Meeting Law by convening a March 19, 2018 executive session under Purpose 3 for a discussion of the merits of a site plan application, and declined to review an untimely March 5 executive session allegation.

allegations.summary: Alleged the Board improperly used Purpose 3 for a March 19, 2018 executive session on a site plan application, with no litigation pending or imminently threatened.
allegations.key_passage: Accordingly, we find that the Board violated the Open Meeting Law by convening in executive session under Purpose 3 for this discussion.

allegations.summary: Alleged an improper executive session on March 5, 2018; the complaint conceded it was filed with the Board beyond the 30-day deadline.
allegations.key_passage: Accordingly, we decline to review the propriety of this executive session as the allegation was untimely filed with the Board.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law's requirements.
Publicly release the March 19, 2018 executive session minutes, without any redaction or withholding.
remedy_passage: We order the Board's immediate and future compliance with the law's requirements, and we caution that similar future violations could be considered evidence of intent to violate the law.
note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
